title: Mirror the King
setup: White's king has just stepped in front of the d-pawn, and Black must choose where to stand.
hint: Whatever square you take, White will try to slip past on one wing; which one lets you copy it both ways?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Kd7}} is the only square that holds. From there Black just copies: {{Kc5}} is met by {{Kc7}}, and {{Ke5}} by {{Ke7}}. Stand anywhere else and the white king reaches the sixth rank in front of its pawn, which is all a king and pawn ever need.
